meta.purpose: Machine-readable normalisation of the two reviewer passes in review-pass1.json and review-pass2.json, so that the three agreement criteria (identity, rights tier, extraction path) can be computed instead of eyeballed. Written by the registry builder by reading the reviewers' own text. Every entry in 'basis' is a phrase that must occur verbatim in the reviewer's output for that entry (checked by tests/sources-qc/registry.test.mjs); nothing here is a new finding.
meta.adapter_rule: Extraction paths agree when the sets of adapters each reviewer verified by reading ('adapters_read') intersect AND both name the same edition of the same work. The agreed adapter is the intersection (first element is the preferred one).
